name: STAND! For Families Free of Violence
description: Crisis support, advocacy, counseling, and family services in Contra Costa
fullDescription: STAND! provides family violence services throughout Contra Costa County, including a 24/7 crisis line, safety planning, case management, legal advocacy, support groups, children's therapy, and prevention education.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 crisis hotline with emotional support, safety planning, and referrals
- Community advocates: crisis intervention, case management, legal and systems advocacy, accompaniment
- Support groups
- Children's therapy and youth services
- Youth Education Support Services (teen dating violence prevention)
- 52-week Non-Violence Program (court-ordered batterers' intervention, English and Spanish)
howToGetIt:
1. Call 24-hour crisis line: 888-215-5555
2. Or email: crisisline@standffov.org
3. Drop in at a Family Justice Center: Concord (2151 Salvio St, Suite 201), Richmond (256 24th St), or Antioch (5065 Deer Valley Rd, Suite 112)
4. Speak with a trained advocate and receive safety planning
5. Non-Violence Program: 925-676-2968
6. All services confidential
keywords: STAND, Contra Costa County, crisis line, safety planning, case management, legal advocacy, support groups, children's therapy, youth services, Family Justice Center, 888-215-5555
